case_title: KESTEN STEVEN VS KAHN RHONI DBA LOOSE ENDS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $148.00 FILED BY KESTEN STEVEN AS TO DEFENDANT KAHN RHONI DBA LOOSE ENDS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-14-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT KAHN RHONI DBA LOOSE ENDS
SUBPOENA DUCES TECUM ISSUED TO BANK RECORDS FOR CHECKING ACCOUNT.
THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KESTEN STEVEN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT KAHN RHONI DBA LOOSE ENDS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGEMENT TO DEF.RETURNED. VACANT.
